visual_logic.color_palette: Sleek slate-blue dorsal side with a shimmering silver underbelly; tail vane is a vibrant 'hazard' orange.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: High-gloss 'wet' skin texture; horizontal counter-shading to mimic modern seabirds.
visual_logic.eyes: Piercing icy-blue eyes with a high-shine finish.
visual_logic.environment: Moonlit Solnhofen lagoon; calm water with bioluminescent algae ripples.

pose: Skimming just above the water surface, jaw dipped low; the long tail is held perfectly horizontal to provide aerodynamic stability.
